profile.headline: Software Engineer at Hoganix
profile.summary: Software and Data Services Professional with experience in engineering, developing client relationships, supporting management, analyzing data, and approving high-dollar financial transactions. Ability to oversee complex finance projects while timely completing deadlines. Experienced in implementing policies to increase efficiency for a company and decrease costs for clients.

positions.title: Change Control Coordinator
positions.description:
●	Tracked and managed project release dates and milestones
●	Engaged in opportunities to improve and develop financial products for increased client satisfaction which led to increased efficiency
●	Vetted system changes ensuring no unnecessary changes are made
●	Determined impact to Information Technology services that use infrastructure and impact to resources needed to perform implementation on schedule.

positions.title: Lead Mutual Fund Representative
positions.description:
●	Reviewed and approved financial transactions between $100,00 and $150,000 totalling over $250 million as Lead Mutual Fund Representative
●	Maintained dedicated, professional, and productive relationships with clients, including The Principal Financial Group and MFS Investment Group, through outstanding customer service and product knowledge.
●	Identified errors in investment products and implement policies to improve fund processing and increase efficiency while decreasing costs to clients.
●	Coached and mentored Flex Time Mutual Fund Representatives on company-based financial products and policies.

positions.title: Senior Mutual Fund Representative
positions.description:
●	Reviewed and approved financial transactions between $50,000 and $150,000 totaling over $250 million.
●	Strategized with management to standardize processes to adhere to SEC regulations and improve the company’s internal database.
●	Identified inefficiencies in processing mutual fund products by using data visualization and narration abilities.
●	Processed financial transactions including purchases, redemptions and transfers.
●	Improved client processes resulting in consistent client recognition (HOW?).
●	Adapted to high stress situations while multi-tasking with client deliverables which resulted in frequent “Exceeds Expectations” ratings in performance evaluations.
